commit.subject: LU-20366 tests: disable statahead on sanity/124e/f
commit.message:
LU-20366 tests: disable statahead on sanity/124e/f

Set llite.*.enable_statahead_fname=0 with the intention to
disable `stat()` randomness in this test, to reduce flakiness.

Drive LFRU behavior via stat() instead of ls to reduce flakiness
during priv eviction and threshold adjustment as well.

Test-Parameters: trivial clientdistro=ubuntu2604 testlist=sanity \
  env=ONLY=124e,ONLY=124f,ONLY_REPEAT=200
Test-Parameters: trivial clientdistro=el10.1 serverdistro=el10.1 \
  testlist=sanity env=ONLY=124e,ONLY=124f,ONLY_REPEAT=200
Signed-off-by: kxu <kxu@ddn.com>
Change-Id: Iaea95acca0ba27b1f1975033e69c4f678e01752d
